run_versiongenerate: run versiongenerate.py with input_dir and output_dir to extract version from configure.ac and write Version.h
extract_version_from_configure_ac: extract the major, minor, and fix version numbers from a configure.ac file using the AC_INIT macro regex
generate_version_header: generate a Version.h header file with GTEST_VERSIONINFO_SHORT and GTEST_VERSIONINFO_LONG defines from extracted version
parse_ac_init_version: parse the AC_INIT macro in configure.ac to extract a three-part version string in square brackets
review_versiongenerate_script: review the versiongenerate.py script that reads configure.ac and writes a Version.h header for gtest Info.plist
